errors.text_span: Линията започва при стойност около 19000 в 2012 г.
errors.evidence: The description states that the line starts at a value of around 19000 in 2012, but the figure shows the starting value is lower, approximately 18000-18500. The value of 19000 is reached around the year 2013.

errors.text_span: показвайки по-бързо нарастване на БВП на човек от населението
errors.evidence: The description interprets the steeper slope of the line after 2016 as 'showing faster growth of GDP per capita'. The prompt requires describing only the visual information without making interpretations or conclusions. A more neutral description would have been to just state that the slope of the line increases.
